messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api/us-east-1 queue depth rising rapidly. p95 -> 12s, p99 -> 24s. GPU pool utilization 95%. backlog +120k reqs in 5m. autoscaler errors observed. @oncall please triage

sam: seeing it, joining. looking at autoscaler logs and provisioner metrics.

maya: i'm oncall, taking lead. sam you have the bridge? i'll pull up runbooks.

sam: bridge up: https://reddot.internal/bridges/1746609999 :05

leo: quick note — provisioner shows `QuotaExceeded: GPU cores quota` around 1746609960 and repeated `429` from cloud provider. autoscaler tried 3x and failed.

sam: copying errors: ```Provisioner error: CreateInstance failed: quotaExceeded: requested 8 gpus, available 0
Autoscaler: launch attempt 3 failed, retrying in 30s
Provisioner logs: RateLimitExceeded: 9 calls/min -> throttled
```

nina: Support: customers reporting timeouts, several 5xx inbound from hosted API. Customer-facing page shows degraded in us-east. Pinged CSMs.

maya: mitigation plan (short): 1) enable fallback routing to smaller, quantized model variant (lower GPU req) 2) apply temporary stricter rate limit to non-verified/free tenants 3) enable edge-cache for repeated prompts 4) open cloud quota ticket and request emergency quota bump

sam: executing 1 & 2 now. applying route change: ```POST /internal/routing/update {"route":"fallback-small","match":"hosted-us-east"}``` -> 200 OK

sam: applying rate limit rule: ```/internal/ratelimit set --group free-tenants --rps 5``` -> pushed, effective 30s

leo: added temporary thin-pool allocation for dedicated reserved nodes we control. provisioner still throttled for new instances but we can shift some traffic to dedicated pool. doing drain/proxy config.

maya: good. can we enable degradation banner for affected customers? nina please coordinate.

nina: banner up, status page updated: "Degraded performance in us-east-1 due to capacity constraints. Mitigations in progress." Slack CSM thread created.

sam: test traffic looks better offloaded to fallback model: p95 dropped from 12s -> 3.1s for sampled requests. queue depth decreasing.

maya: leaving to handoff to leo for capacity follow-up and cloud ticket. I'm going offline at 1746610200 for a hard stop, leo takes page. :wave:

leo: taking over. opened cloud support ticket 12345678, requested quota bump + expedite. also filing infra-ops change: request temporary provider rate limit exemption for provisioner calls.

ops: FYI — scheduled jobs that spike provisioning (nightly backfills) were coincidentally running. paused them cluster-wide.

leo: current status at 1746611400 — queue trending down, GPU util 78%, p95 ~2.9s, p99 ~7.6s. still monitoring. will stay until cloud confirms quota change or until autoscaler stabilized.

sam: filing incident doc + customer impact summary. will include timelines and runbook gaps (provider rate-limit handling).

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). tags: capacity, autoscaler, quota, fallback-routing.

maya: thanks team. postmortem owners: sam (exec), leo (infra), nina (customer comms). follow-up: add autoscaler backoff jitter, detect quotaExceeded earlier and preemptively redirect.

sam: noted. will sync tomorrow 10:00 PST for postmortem write-up. :white_check_mark:
